messages:
Maya (docs): Heads-up — I pushed a first-pass of the release notes for the upcoming docs deploy to the PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/482. Need quick review on: feature bullets, known-issue wording, and SDK snippet parity.

Jon S: Thanks — skimmed. Two small asks: 1) call out the new batching config under 'Optimize' as a beta flag; 2) can we include exact SDK call example for Node streaming? Right now it's only Python.

Alesha: Noted. Also spotted a regression: embedding streaming deprecation paragraph still references the old endpoint path (/v1/embeds/stream). We need to replace with the new unified embeddings API and add a small migration note.

Max G: I updated the Node snippet to be consistent with the SDK 2.1 surface and fixed the await/stream handling. snippet diff: ```js
const stream = await client.responses.stream({model: 'rw-infer-1', input: 'hello'});
for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text) }
```
Link to commit: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/commit/abcd1234

Maya (docs): Perfect — @Max G can you also add a short note about tokenization differences when switching quantized models? We've had at least one customer question on that.

Max G: Yup will add a 2-sentence callout under 'Known issues' about slight tokenization boundary differences with q2_k gems and recommend the eval prompt set check.

Jon S: For the 'What's new' bullets, can we make the phrasing less marketing-y and more concrete? e.g., instead of "improved throughput", say "up to 3x throughput on short-chat workloads with intelligent batching (measured on rw-infer-1)" — include measurement note in parentheses.

Alesha: Also cross-check redirect health for three doc links I found: /docs/guides/streaming, /docs/sdk/node/examples, /docs/release-notes/previous. One of them 301s to an internal preview URL and breaks the site link check. I can open a redirect-fix PR if someone points to the canonical path.

Maya (docs): Thanks — assigning tasks: @Max G add Node snippet update + quantization note; @Alesha handle redirect PR; @Jon S polish bullets and add measurement parenthesis. I'll bake changes into the PR and ping for a final review.

deploy-bot: Preview build is ready at https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/changes/482 (expires in 72h).

Jon S: Quick UX nit — the SDK example has a dangling code block fence in the markdown preview (renders raw). Might be missing a newline before the fence. I'll patch in the PR comment.

Maya (docs): Great catch. If we can get these three fixes in by EOD, I can merge and schedule the docs deploy tomorrow morning. If not, we'll gate the 'Optimize' beta mention behind a follow-up note.

Alesha: I'll open the redirect-fix PR in the next 30m and tag you.

Max G: Node snippet + q-note pushed in branch docs/snippet-node-482, PR linked in thread.

Maya (docs): Excellent — thank you all. Once merged I'll run the smoke check on staging and share any last-minute known-issue edits here. :thumbsup:
